inlines.v: TRANSPLANT', verb transitive [Latin planto.] 1. To remove and plant in another place; as, to transplant trees. 2. To remove and settle or establish for residence in another place; as, to transplant inhabitants. Salmaneser transplanted the Cuthites to Samaria. 3. To remove.
